english: Sorry dear, you'll have to wait until I've heard more things to share!
french: Je suis désolée, mon chou, mais tu devras attendre que j'aie d'autres potins à partager avec toi !
russian: Прости, дорогуша, придётся подождать, пока до меня дойдут новые слухи!
bulgarian: Sorry dear, you'll have to wait until I've heard more things to share!

english: Don't be shy, [Ari]! Let me know who you want to chat about.
french: Ne sois pas timide, [Ari] ! Dis-moi de qui tu as envie que nous parlions.
russian: Не стесняйся, [Ari]! Скажи, о ком тебе хочется посплетничать.
bulgarian: Don't be shy, [Ari]! Let me know who you want to chat about.

english: Let me regale you with the latest gossip, [Ari]!
french: Je vais te régaler avec les tout derniers potins, [Ari] !
russian: Позволь поделиться с тобой свежими сплетнями, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Let me regale you with the latest gossip, [Ari]!

english: I think you're going to like this one, [Ari].
french: Je pense que cette histoire va bien te plaire, [Ari].
russian: Думаю, тебе понравится, что я расскажу, [Ari].
bulgarian: I think you're going to like this one, [Ari].

english: Oh, [Ari], you simply must hear about this...
french: Oh [Ari], il faut absolument que tu entendes ça...
russian: Ох, [Ari], тебе обязательно надо это услышать...
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari], you simply must hear about this...

english: Even in a small town like Mistria, there's always plenty of gossip!
french: Même dans une petite ville comme Mistria, il y a toujours de quoi faire, niveau potins !
russian: Даже в таком небольшом городке, как Мистрия всегда полно сплетен!
bulgarian: Even in a small town like Mistria, there's always plenty of gossip!

english: There's nothing quite like a little gossip to add intrigue to the day.
french: Rien ne vaut quelques petits potins pour ajouter un peu de piment à la journée.
russian: Чтобы день не прошёл без интриги, лучше всего поделиться слухами!
bulgarian: There's nothing quite like a little gossip to add intrigue to the day.

english: I've been excited to share this with you...
french: J'avais hâte de te raconter ça...
russian: Я так хочу тебе кое-что рассказать...
bulgarian: I've been excited to share this with you...

english: I heard something most intriguing, [Ari]. Would you like to hear?
french: J'ai appris quelque chose d'assez piquant, [Ari]. Tu veux que je te le répète ?
russian: У меня есть для тебя весьма интригующие новости, [Ari]. Хочешь послушать?
bulgarian: I heard something most intriguing, [Ari]. Would you like to hear?

english: It seems you know this town as well as I do, [Ari]! I'm all out of gossip for you.
french: Apparemment, tu connais cette ville aussi bien que moi, [Ari] ! Je n'ai plus aucun potin à te raconter.
russian: Кажется, ты всё про всех знаешь не хуже меня, [Ari]! У меня больше нет для тебя сплетен.
bulgarian: It seems you know this town as well as I do, [Ari]! I'm all out of gossip for you.
